video: 60-second vertical explainer that shows beginners how INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE change a table of shop products, and what happens when WHERE is left out

camera_move.what: The camera pans and zooms smoothly to the part of the picture being explained, then back out to show everything

camera_breathing.what: The whole picture slowly and very slightly zooms in and out in a continuous loop, so held frames do not look frozen

headline_reveal.what: Each headline line slides up into view from behind a mask

headline_exit.what: The headline fades out just before the next scene

subtitle_bar_fade.what: The subtitle bar fades in when a spoken line starts and fades out when it ends

subtitle_word_reveal.what: Subtitle words brighten in groups of three as they are spoken

card_outline_draw.what: The outline of a table or card draws itself, then the card fills in

table_rows_wipe.what: Each row of a table is revealed from left to right, one row after another

chip_wipe.what: A small label chip is revealed from left to right

query_typing.what: One line of the query is typed letter by letter

world_exit.what: The tables and the query card fade away to make room for the logo

logo_bars_grow.what: The four logo bars grow upward one after another from left to right

wordmark_reveal.what: The DataEntropy wordmark is revealed from left to right

logo_glow.what: A soft violet glow brightens around the logo bars and settles

tagline_enter.what: The tagline is revealed from left to right under the wordmark

cta_arrow_nudge.what: The arrow in the button nudges to the right once

question_mark_enter.what: A large violet question mark fades in beside the products table

price_out.what: The old price in a row slides up and fades out
price_out.scene: three commands, UPDATE, no WHERE, DELETE

price_in.what: The new price slides up into its place
price_in.scene: three commands, UPDATE, no WHERE, DELETE

command_chip_wipe.what: A chip with the name of a command is revealed from left to right beside the table

command_chip_light.what: The chip of the command being shown turns from white to violet

new_row_slide_in.what: A new row inside a white chip slides up into the first free line of the table

new_row_chip_exit.what: The chip around the new row fades away once it is in the table

table_grow.what: The table gets one row taller to hold the new row

query_line_out.what: A line of the query slides up and fades out
query_line_out.scene: UPDATE, no WHERE, DELETE, SELECT first

query_line_in.what: A new line of the query slides up into its place

price_ring_draw.what: A violet outline draws itself around the one price that changes

where_marks_wipe.what: A lavender band spreads from left to right behind the WHERE line of the query and behind the one row it picks

where_marks_exit.what: The lavender bands and the outline around the price fade away

row_delete_fade.what: The deleted row fades out of the table

table_close_gap.what: The row below moves up and the table gets one row shorter

rows_wipe_out.what: Every remaining row fades out of the table, one after another

rows_return.what: The rows fade back into the table

check_ring_draw.what: A violet outline draws itself around the row the WHERE would touch

check_draw.what: A violet check mark fades in beside that row

check_exit.what: The outline and the check mark fade away

final_mark_wipe.what: A lavender band spreads from left to right behind the WHERE line of the query
